Using polars to do basic corpus searching


```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-14T22:02:13.589586Z', start_time: '2026-06-14T22:02:13.576710Z'}
import polars as pl
import polars.selectors as cs
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-14T22:02:17.616045Z', start_time: '2026-06-14T22:02:16.775037Z'}
bnc = pl.read_parquet("../../bnc.parquet")
bnc.head(10)
```

## Token frequency

### Absolute frequency

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-14T22:02:55.903098Z', start_time: '2026-06-14T22:02:52.651417Z'}
abs_freq = bnc['token'].value_counts(sort=True)
abs_freq.head()
```

### Relative frequency

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-14T22:04:00.734180Z', start_time: '2026-06-14T22:03:57.788968Z'}
rel_freq = ( bnc['token']
             .value_counts(normalize=True, sort=True)
             .with_columns(pl.col('proportion')*100000)
             )
rel_freq.head()
```

### Zipf's Law

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-14T22:04:22.360421Z', start_time: '2026-06-14T22:04:16.745556Z'}
zipf = ( bnc['token'].str.to_lowercase()
         .value_counts(sort=True)
         .with_row_index("rank", offset=1)
         )
sns.lineplot(data=zipf.head(50), x="rank", y="count")
```

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-14T22:04:29.965866Z', start_time: '2026-06-14T22:04:29.552562Z'}
plt.loglog()
sns.lineplot(data=zipf, x="rank", y="count")
```

## Dispersion

### Range2

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-14T22:04:49.448708Z', start_time: '2026-06-14T22:04:44.072874Z'}
n_file_ids = bnc.select(pl.col('file_id').n_unique()).item()
r2 = ( bnc.group_by('lemma')
       .agg((pl.col('file_id').n_unique()/n_file_ids*100).alias('r2'))
       .sort(by="r2", descending=True)
       )
r2.head()
```

Brezina pg. 26

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:12.764671Z', start_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:12.341109Z'}
the = (
    bnc.filter(mode="spoken")
    .group_by("file_id")
    .agg(
        (
            pl.col("lemma").len().alias("n"),
            (pl.col("lemma") == "the").sum().alias("the"),
            (pl.col("lemma") == "i").sum().alias("i"),
            (pl.col("lemma") == "you").sum().alias("you"),
        )
    )
    .select("file_id", (cs.numeric().exclude("n") / pl.col("n") * 10000))
    .sort(by="file_id")
)

the.head(10)
```

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:14.243100Z', start_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:14.036165Z'}
sns.histplot(the.to_pandas(), y="the")
```

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:15.410759Z', start_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:15.297879Z'}
sns.lmplot(
    the.to_pandas(),
    x="the",
    y="i",
    scatter_kws={"alpha": 0.25},
    line_kws={"color": "red"},
)
```

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:16.290403Z', start_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:15.951380Z'}
sns.pairplot(
    the.to_pandas(),
    vars=["the", "i", "you"],
    kind="reg",
    corner=True,
    plot_kws={"scatter_kws": {"alpha": 0.1}, "line_kws": {"color": "red"}},
)
```

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:18.113950Z', start_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:17.287934Z'}
hits = bnc.filter(
    pl.col("lemma").is_in(["very", "really", "rather", "quite"]), pl.col("c5") == "AV0"
)
counts = (
    hits.group_by("lemma", "text_type")
    .agg(pl.len().alias("count"))
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("count") / pl.col("count").sum().over("text_type") * 100).alias("pct")
    )
)
counts
```

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:18.785974Z', start_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:18.682773Z'}
hits = bnc.filter(pl.col("lemma").is_in(["very", "really"]))

ratio = (
    hits.group_by("text_type")
    .agg(
        ((pl.col("token") == "very").sum() / (pl.col("token") == "really").sum()).alias(
            "ratio"
        )
    )
    .sort(by="ratio")
)
ratio
```
